subject.title: fix(infra): drop replacement characters when response snippets truncate UTF-8

question: Should OpenClaw accept the Plugin SDK-visible diagnostic text change that drops incomplete trailing UTF-8 sequences and treats exact byte-budget diagnostic prefixes as truncated?
rationale: The implementation is well-scoped and covered, but it changes observable diagnostic text through a public SDK runtime subpath, so maintainer intent is needed for the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the diagnostic cleanup
options.body: Land after conflict resolution because the change removes invented replacement characters while preserving strict success-body limits and existing signatures.

options.title: Request explicit compatibility context
options.body: Ask for PR-body or squash-message context that bounded diagnostic snippets may omit incomplete trailing UTF-8 and mark exact-cap prefixes truncated.

options.title: Pause if exact diagnostics are contract-sensitive
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want exact diagnostic byte-cap output preserved for external plugin assertions.

recommendation.title: Accept the diagnostic cleanup
recommendation.body: Land after conflict resolution because the change removes invented replacement characters while preserving strict success-body limits and existing signatures.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest centralizing commits, so they are the clearest owner for accepting or narrowing the SDK-visible compatibility tradeoff.
